Enabled.Name: Automatic translation
Enabled.Hint: Translates documents into French when they are created.

OnlyPlutonium.Name: Plutonium imports only
OnlyPlutonium.Hint: Only translate documents created by Plutonium. Uncheck to translate every created document.

ShowAltUnits.Name: Show distance equivalent
ShowAltUnits.Hint: Shows the distance in the opposite unit in small text (feet ↔ meters).

TranslateInterface.Name: Translate sheet interface
TranslateInterface.Hint: When the badge is on FR, also translates the sheet's labels, tabs and tooltips (from installed French language files, otherwise with the model).

Notify.Downloading: Truchement: downloading the translation model (~75 MB, once)…
Notify.ModelError: Truchement: translation model unavailable, only rule sentences are translated (see console).

Badge.None: Truchement: not translated — click to translate
Badge.Fr: Truchement: translation shown — click: see the original · Shift+click: retranslate
Badge.En: Truchement: original shown — click: back to the translation · Shift+click: retranslate
